Theme

House layout, roofs, rooms & furnishings

basement noun

also underground vault, cellar

classical

Vitruvius 6.8.1: sīn autem hypogēa concamarātiōnēsque īnstituentur, fundātiōnēs eōrum fierī dēbent crassiōrēs
Traupman 122
Traupman 288

hypogēum, hypogēī n.

noun, second declension

basement, underground vault

Also hypogaeum. It can also mean a burial vault (Petronius 111.2); on a building site the Vitruvian sense is clear.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) cella subterrānea

    also used · * our formation

    For Theo.

  • cellārium subterrāneum — cellar, basement

    also used · modern · Traupman 122; Traupman 288

    Cellārium is classically a pantry or store for food (Dig., Lewis & Short); cella is the classical word for a storeroom.

See also ground level, foundations.
